promotionPolicy: Organization/project/request rules coexist; conflict must be surfaced. Private knowledge is not automatically promoted. Human approval is required for reusable knowledge registration.

items.principle: Normal text generally needs 4.5:1 contrast; large text 3:1. Evaluate exceptions explicitly.
items.boundary: DIF computes opaque sRGB declarations only; this is not whole-page WCAG conformance.

items.principle: Plan keyboard access and visible focus for essential controls.
items.boundary: Model booleans are declarations, not browser/assistive-technology tests.

items.principle: Avoid unaided cognitive-function tests; support appropriate assistance or alternatives.
items.boundary: Review the full criterion and exceptions for the actual system.

items.principle: Preserve safe input, explain recovery and separate retry from starting over.
items.boundary: Expected usability benefit requires user research.

items.version: Living guidance; source research 2026-10-11; not an immutable release
items.appliesTo: Platform-specific proposals and reviews, scoped to the target OS/library
items.principle: Consult current platform guidance before making platform conformance claims.
items.boundary: Selected detailed-control sources inspected; not a platform conformance evaluator. See dif-controls source register.

items.version: Living guidance; source research 2026-10-11; not an immutable release
items.appliesTo: Platform-specific proposals and reviews, scoped to the target OS/library
items.principle: Consult the applicable Material version for platform-specific behavior.
items.boundary: Selected detailed-control sources inspected; not a platform conformance evaluator. See dif-controls source register.

items.principle: 24 by 24 CSS px or applicable criterion exceptions including spacing; do not equate this minimum with native pt/dp guidance.
items.boundary: Understanding is informative; inspect the normative criterion and exceptions. No automatic compliance judgment is implemented.

items.principle: Provide a single-pointer non-drag alternative subject to the criterion exceptions; keyboard support is a separate requirement.
items.boundary: A slider value field or other equivalent pointer path needs actual runtime verification.

items.appliesTo: Apple platform sliders with platform-specific exceptions
items.principle: Consider exact-value input or a stepper alongside a slider; distinguish iOS/iPadOS system audio volume from generic app parameters.
items.boundary: Do not generalize macOS or other platform sections to iOS. Source guidance is not native-device evidence.

items.principle: Use the applicable 48dp minimum-target guidance and inspect expanded-hit-area overlap; rendered icon size is not the hit area.
items.boundary: Logical dp, not Web CSS px or physical screenshot pixels; actual semantics and targets still need testing.

items.principle: A switch represents an immediate effect; use other selection controls for mutually exclusive choices or multiple draft choices requiring save.
items.boundary: Not a universal OS rule. Persisted state and failed changes require explicit design.

items.principle: Separate valid preview, raw draft input and committed value. Preserve drafts on failed save and specify back/reset/undo behavior.
items.boundary: User-requested knowledge expansion; not an empirical performance claim or an external standard.

items.principle: Plan reflow at the criterion dimensions and exceptions; preserve tasks across portrait/landscape without unnecessary orientation locks.
items.boundary: WCAG 1.4.10 and 1.3.4 are separate criteria. A 320 CSS px screenshot is not full zoom or physical-rotation evidence.

items.appliesTo: Adaptive Android windows; transferable design reasoning must be labeled
items.principle: Use available window dimensions instead of inferring layout from device names; consider split views and short height.
items.boundary: Native dp/window guidance is not a Web CSS breakpoint rule. Device recreation and safe areas require native verification.

items.principle: Define semantic color roles and alternate appearances; inspect state legibility and material hierarchy instead of blanket inversion.
items.boundary: Source research does not prove custom UI contrast, real display gamut or native rendering.

items.principle: SC 2.3.3 is AAA: permit disabling interaction motion unless essential; preserve meaningful state feedback.
items.boundary: Automatic moving content has separate requirements. Reduced-motion CSS alone is not whole-product conformance.

items.principle: Specify transformations, density, text growth, semantic palette, material details and interruptible motion; demonstrate critical transitions.
items.boundary: User-authorized synthesis; emulator, author critique and real user/device findings must remain separate.

items.principle: Compare font loading policy, subset coverage and fallback behavior against the actual content and delivery constraints.
items.boundary: Does not prove rendered glyph selection, license permissions or measured performance.

items.appliesTo: Font, plugin, framework and UI architecture decisions
items.principle: Inspect the current stack, connect choices to product requirements and preserve responsibility, state and persistence boundaries in architecture decisions.
items.boundary: Documented proposals do not establish actual compatibility, native fidelity, production architecture or human adoption.

items.principle: Define shared semantic components, sanctioned token overrides, state ownership and migration boundaries; demonstrate change propagation across real consumers.
items.boundary: A catalogue or token file does not establish consistent use, accessibility or measured maintenance savings.
